answer: Spectral partition barriers impose a Cheeger gap: the normalized cut bounds the Dirichlet form, so walk mass cannot wander across the honest-adversary interface. Personalized EigenTrust attenuates via a row-stochastic matrix, confining any adversary plume to a decaying residual. This residual is an ember; in limit, honest validator trust converges to the invariant subspace, excluding adversarial weight.
